topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by framing the session's themes, practical histopathology connections, and intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Assays for Cellular Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and established experimental assays to evaluate transforming potential.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Classifications of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes and illustrate how specific mutations perturb cell cycle control and protein activity.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Manifestations of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how defects in distinct DNA repair pathways and mitotic chromosome segregation produce sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer.

topics.label: Multistep Progression, Hereditary Predisposition, and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how the stepwise accumulation of inherited or somatic genetic alterations drives tumor initiation, progression, and therapeutic evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding framing for the lecture with recommended reading and an outlook on the next session.
